title: Electric two-wheeler sales hit record 2.24 lakh units in October on festive demand, new models
summary: Electric two wheeler sales hit record 2.24 lakh units in October on festive demand
detailed: TVS Motor retained its leadership in October, nearly doubling registrations to 60,433 units and expanding its market share to 27% from 20.6% in the same month last year.
